principles.name: Show the work
principles.detail: We judge analysis by the documents it produces and the decisions it makes possible.

principles.name: Say it plainly
principles.detail: Short sentences, plain English, and every term explained the first time.

principles.name: Promise what we control
principles.detail: We don't promise jobs, salaries or certifications. We promise the work and honest feedback on it.

principles.name: Teach from practice
principles.detail: What we teach comes from work done in real organisations, not from slides.
